observations.name: EU and AM keep working during the APAC partition
observations.expected: >= 95% of EU/AM commands acknowledged while APAC is cut off

observations.name: global consumer lanes during the partition
observations.expected: a lane held by a cut-off JVM is released within ~30 s (keepalive) and taken over
observations.expectedBeforeFix: the lane stays stuck on an orphaned advisory lock until Postgres kills the backend (G25)
observations.observed: longest checkpoint stall per lane (s): {EU/order-observer_NotificationObserver_1_*=10, EU/order-query_OrderProjector_1_*=10, consumers/order-query_CatalogProjector_1_ALL=55}
observations.note: A stall also happens legitimately when no new event arrives; load keeps producing EU/AM events.

observations.name: I6 convergence after healing
observations.expected: read models reach the event store's state within 240 s

observations.name: no duplicate projection/saga side effects (I2)
observations.expected: one OrderCreated per order; no key stored twice; observer deliveries = 1; payment attempts = 1
observations.expectedBeforeFix: two replicas process one lane after the partition; the stale one re-applies (G11)

invariants.name: no lost events
invariants.expected: every 2xx-acknowledged command has its event in es__events
invariants.observed: 0 of 107 acknowledged ops missing; 0 unacknowledged ops were stored anyway

invariants.name: no duplicate events or side effects
invariants.expected: one OrderCreated per order; no key stored twice; observer deliveries = 1; payment attempts = 1

invariants.name: no aggregate fork
invariants.expected: every story is valid under the aggregate's rules; sequence numbers unique

invariants.name: regional isolation
invariants.expected: order_view of each cell database contains only that cell's contexts

invariants.name: global completeness
invariants.expected: order_view_global = union of the cells' order_view (same ids, status, item count, context)
invariants.observed: 0 missing in global, 0 missing regionally, 0 mismatched

invariants.name: convergence
invariants.expected: read models reach the event store's state within 240 s

invariants.name: catalog matches live bundles
invariants.expected: core__bundle / core__handler / core__consumer list every live bundle, handler and consumer
invariants.observed: 0 bundle(s), 0 handler(s), 7 consumer(s) missing; 0 bundle(s) without handler rows

invariants.name: command latency per region
invariants.expected: recorded as a baseline (p50/p95/p99), not a pass/fail
invariants.observed: n=119 ack=107 failed=12 p50=470ms p95=4003ms p99=44999ms max=45001ms failures={client_timeout=2, http_504=10}
